chars.RACHID: RACHID: a Moroccan police officer around 30, short black hair, trimmed black beard, wearing a dark navy police uniform with light-blue shirt, navy cap and a bright yellow reflective vest
chars.KARIM: KARIM: a stocky bald Moroccan police officer around 35, clean-shaven, dark navy police uniform with light-blue shirt, no vest
chars.DRIVER: DRIVER: a thin Moroccan man in his 40s with bloodshot eyes and messy curly hair, wearing a red-and-white striped tracksuit jacket and a gold chain
chars.JUDGE: JUDGE: an older Moroccan investigating judge with grey hair and glasses, black judicial robe with white collar

scenes.name: n1.png
scenes.scene: Night police checkpoint on a Moroccan highway near Rabat, RACHID leans toward the open window of an old white car and stares hard at DRIVER, who grips the steering wheel and glares back nervously, red and blue light on their faces, tense confrontation

scenes.name: n2.png
scenes.scene: Close view through the car window: DRIVER sweating, eyes wide and twitching, laughing strangely, while RACHID shines a flashlight on him with a suspicious frown

scenes.name: n3.png
scenes.scene: The open car trunk at night is packed with many brown wrapped bricks of hashish, RACHID and KARIM look inside in shock, DRIVER stands beside them pale with his hands on his head

scenes.name: n4.png
scenes.scene: Beside the car on a dark empty road, DRIVER secretly opens a black bag full of banknotes and holds it toward RACHID with a pleading sly smile, RACHID looks at the money tempted

scenes.name: n5.png
scenes.scene: On an empty dark roadside with no one around, RACHID and KARIM exchange a long tempted look, the bag of money between them, greedy guilty expressions

scenes.name: n6.png
scenes.scene: RACHID leans close and whispers a deal to DRIVER, holding up two fingers, while DRIVER listens with hope, only two hashish bricks on the car hood

scenes.name: n7.png
scenes.scene: DRIVER in handcuffs points at RACHID asking anxiously, RACHID nods calmly to reassure him, inside a Moroccan police station office with a desk and a fan

scenes.name: n8.png
scenes.scene: Moroccan courtroom, DRIVER in handcuffs standing between two guards, mouth open in total shock as the sentence falls, wooden benches and a judge bench in the background

scenes.name: n9.png
scenes.scene: In the office of the investigating judge, DRIVER furiously leans over the desk pointing toward the door, telling everything, JUDGE listens very seriously with a pen raised
